desc: Jaya and Yogi decide to take a short trip, but their journey turns wacky, emotional, and unforgettable as they stumble upon strange twists and memories.

desc: Police Commissioner Suryadeo Singh appoints weapons expert Karan to protect his daughter Kajal. Unaware of his covert mission, Kajal grows close to Karan and falls in love with him.

desc: Adil and Kabir infiltrate a Naxal group on a risky mission. As their plan succeeds, Kabir's growing sympathy divides loyalties, sparking a tense clash with his closest friend.

desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
